verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm that provides advisory services such as venture financing, IP and data protection, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence does not show it ships any developer API: the probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404, and its online tools (investor-readiness checker, UPC tracker) are client-facing resources, not APIs.
